bullets.text: The Tiruvallur municipality's sewage is mixing into the Cooum river and threatening Chennai drinking water, prompting field inspections by officials; the office should monitor the remediation.
The Southern Railway urged the relocation of 43 Tasmac shops near railway stations in Chennai due to safety issues, and the office should track any administrative action taken.

The AAI submitted a Detailed Project Report to the Tamil Nadu government for an elevated road connecting Tambaram-Porur Road with Chennai airport to target traffic congestion, which the office should watch.
Adambakkam MRTS station remains shut for seven months due to a design flaw denying residents access, and the office should monitor steps taken to resolve the operational delay.
A Village Administrative Officer and an assistant were arrested in Avadi for taking an 8,000 rupee bribe for a legal heir certificate, and the office should watch for anti-corruption measures.
Kosasthalaiyar river is running dry, threatening 103 villages with drinking water shortages while the board expects monsoon help, and the office should monitor water supply relief efforts.
Fishermen from Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh agreed to use GPS-based demarcation to end Pulicat Lake fishing disputes, and the office should watch for official implementation support.
Starbucks is establishing its first India Global Capability Centre in Chennai to create 800 jobs, and the office should support this employment and IT sector expansion.
Omnicom Group launched a new Global Capability Centre in Coimbatore, boosting Tamil Nadu's Tier-2 tech footprint, and the office should monitor further regional digital investments.
Tesla opened its first Chennai Experience Centre at Express Avenue Mall, expanding regional repair support, and the office should watch for upcoming tech retail milestones.
TVK government withdrew key announcements following public pushback involving Chief Minister Vijay, and the office should monitor policy adjustments and public responses.
Minister Raj Mohan commented that changing the election commissioner is not a solution, and the office should watch for further political developments surrounding this stance.
The Tamil Nadu government launched a maternal welfare scheme to give gold rings to newborns in Chennai government hospitals, and the office should watch the rollout progress.
Prime Minister Modi is scheduled to visit Chennai on October 11 to launch metro rail services, and the BJP is planning a grand welcome which the office should monitor.

'தாய்மாமன் தங்க மோதிரம்' திட்டம்; முதல்வருக்கும், தாய்மார்களுக்குமான பாசப்பிணைப்பின் அடையாளம் - சபாநாயகர் நெகிழ்ச்சி

stories.snippet: சென்னை, சென்னை அரசு மருத்துவமனைகளில் பிறந்த குழந்தைகளுக்கு தாய்மாமன் தங்க மோதிரம் திட்டம் தொடங்கி வைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இது தொடர்பாக வெளியாகியுள்ள அறிக்கையில் தெரிவித்திருப்பதாவது:- தமிழ்நாடு முதலமைச்சர் விஜய் தாய்மாமன்…

stories.title: பிரதமர் மோடி அக். 11-இல் சென்னை வருகை: பிரம்மாண்ட வரவேற்பு அளிக்க பாஜக ஏற்பாடு!
stories.snippet: பிரதமர் மோடி அக். 11-இல் சென்னை வருகை: பிரம்மாண்ட வரவேற்பு அளிக்க பாஜக ஏற்பாடு! சென்னையில் மெட்ரோ ரயில் சேவையை தொடங்கி வைக்க அக். 11-இல் வருகை தரும் பிரதமா் மோடிக்கு பிரம்மாண்ட வரவேற்பு அளிக்க தமிழக பாஜக…
